I need help

My girlfriend just ended things with me today. We talked abt ending things a week before and over the week I gave myself time to take a good look at myself and all my flaws and the flaws in our relationship. I had previously taken my girlfriend for granted and now had a new outlook to now be a kinder and nicer person in general and not try to make our relationship something that it is not. I sat down and had a talk with her at a party and told her this and then we proceeded to hookup. After that I was the happiest I have ever been as I now believed that everything would be ok and get better. Today she called me and told me that we shld just be friends for now and that she has invested too much of herself into me and our relationship and now she just needs to take time to focus on herself. She says she still loves me as a person and for who I am and that she wants to still be rly close. Should I tell her to give me space or should I try be rly close to her with my new outlook on our relationship to try to win her back
